name: fastCRW
description: Installs the fastCRW (crw) web scraper CLI, including its embedded MCP stdio server (crw mcp).

version.description: crw release to install: '0.43.1', 'latest' or another version (a leading 'v' is optional).

userAgent.description: User-Agent for crw (sets CRW_CRAWLER__USER_AGENT unless already set). Empty keeps the crw default.
